gameName: The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth rulebook (Repos Production, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Choose or randomly assign the Fellowship and Sauron; each takes their Unit and Fortress pawns
Central board between you, next to the central play area
{n} Fellowship Units on Arnor and {n} Sauron Units on Mordor
Assemble the Quest of the Ring track below the central board (Nazgul piece on top of Frodo and Sam)
Fellowship takes 3 Coins, Sauron 2; the rest form the reserve
Alliance tokens sorted by Race, each stack shuffled facedown in its notch above the board
Shuffle the Landmark tiles; {n} faceup, the rest in a facedown stack
Sort the Chapter cards into decks 1, 2 and 3 by their runes; shuffle each
Lay out chapter 1 cards in the central area as shown (some faceup, some facedown); the 3 left over go facedown to the discard
Sauron begins: take a Chapter card or a Landmark tile
